question: 在饼图中，占比2%的扇区代表哪个新闻类别？
question_english: In the pie chart, which news category does the 2% slice represent?
model_answer: The pie chart shows the distribution of news categories. The section with a 2% representation corresponds to the "文化" (Culture) category.  The other categories are 体育 (Sports), 社会 (Society), 商务 (Business), 政治 (Politics), 科学 (Science), and 环境保护 (Environmental Protection).
